services.desc: When mom and dad have to hit the road for work before their children have to hit the books, there are few options available to parents for safe, supervised yet entertaining early morning care. Before the Bell offers morning care that lets children ease into their day with breakfast foods and quiet activities, and allows mom and dad to head off to work knowing that their child is enjoying a secure and stimulating environment. This program is held at select school sites. Working parents face all sorts of challenges, and most adults work later than when school lets out. services.name: Swim Lessons
services.desc: Learning to swim is important for every age. It is vital for your personal safety. Along with being a great skill to have learned, it’s a form of exercise to burn calories, reduce pain and improve your overall health. Most of all, swimming is fun! When it comes to fun in and around the water, it’s never too early for swimmers to know what and what not to do. That’s why the St. Charles Park District developed a variety of awareness programs and activities designed to reinforce the “Swimming Safe Saves Lives” message with the Pauly D Foundation.
